subject: Platform
text: Press B to jump across the edge of the platform, causing the first platform to sink down.

evidence.quote:
Hero will follow a cloaked man, to the edge of
a paltform. Press B to jump across, and the first platform will sink
down.

subject: Behemoth
text: Behemoth has 80HP, yields 84 EXP and 3 GP, and uses the physical attack Horn.

evidence.quote:
Behemoth  - 80HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 84      | Battle Strategy: This fight isn't hard. You only have|
| GP: 3        | one weapon, and no item or spells though. Keep       |
O--------------O choosing to attack, and he should die. Although, it  |
| Attack List  | is possible to die, if he gets critical hits to much,|
| ===========  | you'll just start the battle over anyway, so don't   |
| Horn         | worry about it. Horn is just a physical attack.

subject: Hill of Destiny
text: After defeating Behemoth, a quake wipes Hill of Destiny off the map and the cloaked figure tells Hero to meet him in Level Forest.

evidence.quote:
After you defeat Behemoth, another Quake will start. The cloaked figure
will tell you to meet him in Level Forest. Hero leaves, automatically,
as a quake whipes Hill of Destiny off the map. You only have one 
destination on the map - Level Forest.

subject: Man in blue robe
text: Push the stone blocking the man in the blue robe to receive a Tree Wither to show to Kaeli.

evidence.quote:
Well, head north, until you see a man in a blue robe. If you talk to him
you'll find out the stone is blocking his path. Jump over him, and push
the stone, and he'l lthank you. He'll also give you a Tree Wither, and
tell you to show it to a girl named Kaeli.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Head left to find a treasure chest containing 3 potions.

evidence.quote: Head left, and you can get 3 potions from the treasure chest.

subject: Level Forest
text: Head all the way to the right after collecting the potion to exit Level Forest and open the path to Foresta.

evidence.quote:
Head all the way to the right after getting the potion, and you'll leave Level 
Forest, and open the path to Foresta.

subject: Kaeli
text: Talking to Kaeli in the first tree home on the left causes her to see the Tree Wither and join the party.

evidence.quote:
When you enter Foresta, head into the first tree home on the left. There
are two girls at the table in this house; The one on the left is Kaeli.
Talk to her, and she'll see the Tree Wither, and volunteer to help you.
Kaeli joins your party!

subject: Treasure chest
text: In the back of Kaeli's house, a treasure chest holds 3 potions.

evidence.quote:
In the back of Kaeli's house, there is a treasure chest with 3 potions
in it.

subject: Treasure chest
text: The house on the bottom right side of Foresta contains a treasure chest with potions.

evidence.quote:
The house on the right side
of town (the one on the bottom) also has a treasure chest with potions,
if you'd like to get it.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Jump across two logs in the water north of town into the back of a tree home to find a treasure chest containing the Cure spell.

evidence.quote:
Head to the north end of the town, and cross the bridge. On the 
right, in the water, are two logs. Jump across them, to the back of a
tree home. There's a door there, so walk into the house, and there will
be a treasure chest with the Cure spell inside.

subject: Bed
text: Resting in the bed on the left side of the house restores Hero's health.

evidence.quote:
Also, remember, if you
use the bed on the left side of this house, your health will be 
restored.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Treasure chests in Level Forest that look like the potion chest restore when leaving the level.

evidence.quote:
make 
sure to grab thepotion that you got the last time you were here - Chests
that look like this one restore when you leave the level - and you're
good to go.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Defeat the Brownie and Slime on the right to access a chest containing 3 Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
take out the Brownie and the Slime on
the right, to reach a chest with 3 Heal Potions inside.

subject: Minotaur
text: Minotaur has 240HP, gives 84 EXP and 3 GP, and attacks with Axe, Scream, and Roundhouse.

evidence.quote:
Minotaur - 240HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 84      | Battle Strategy: If you have your partner on Manual, |
| GP: 3        | make her attack each turn, unless Hero dies; In which|
O--------------O case, she should use Life to revive him. Use a       |
| Attack List  | similair tactic with Hero. Attack every turn, but use|
| ===========  | Cure if either Kaeli or Hero get low on health. His  |
| Axe          | axe attack is just a physical attack, but his Scream |
| Scream       | ability will do damage, and also lower your defense. |
| Roundhouse   | Also, be prepared for his Roundhouse; It's also a    |
|              | physical attack, but it lays heavier damage.

subject: Minotaur
text: Casting the Life Spell defeats Minotaur in one hit.

evidence.quote:
If you 
want to be cheap, use a Life Spell, to bring him 
down in one hit.

subject: Kaeli
text: After defeating Minotaur, Kaeli leaves the party and gives Hero her axe to cut down trees.

evidence.quote:
After the battle, Kaeli's mom will come, and take Kaeli home. Hero will
volunteer to get the elixer to save Kaili - He's told it's in the Sand
Temple that's a little north. Kaeli will give Hero her axe - You can 
cut trees down now! - and then, they'll leave.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Cut down trees on the south-west section of the map to access a chest containing a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote:
You can access a Brownie and a chest with a Heal Potion by cutting down
trees on the south-west section of the map.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Cut down trees on the south-east to reach a chest with a Potion inside.

evidence.quote:
You can also find a chest 
with a Potion inside it, by cutting down trees on the south-east.

subject: Battlefield
text: Defeating 10 sets of monsters in the battlefield north of Level Forest awards GP, EXP, and 54 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Mad Plant + Poison Toad
Reward - 54 EXP
=================

North of Level Forest, right before Sand Temple, is the first
battlefield. Like all future battelfields, it's optional. Fight 10 sets
of monsters, and earn GP and EXP, and sometimes an item.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam meets Hero at the empty treasure chest in Sand Temple and agrees to accompany him through Bone Dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Walk through the door in the first room, into
second room, and check the one treasure chest there. You'll find it's
empty. Soon, Tristam will come in, and offer to seel you the elixer for
9000 GP... Hero and Tristam will strike a deal though. Tristam will accompany you
through the Bone Dungeon, and he'll give you the Elixer afterwards.... After Tristam joins the party, exit the sand temple.

subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing out the battlefield to the left of Sand Temple awards a Charm armor that increases defense.

evidence.quote:
Before heading to the Bone Dungeon, you really should head left from 
sand Temple, and clear out a battlefield. When you win, you'll pick up
a Charm. The charm is an armor, that will increase your defense, so it's
good to have.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Chests on both the left and right sides of the moving sand each contain 10 Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote:
choose to fight the monsters on either the left or 
right side, to go around the sand - if you do this, there's a chest with
10 Ninja Stars for Tristam, on both sides.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Open the chest at the edge of the moving sand to collect 3 potions.

evidence.quote:
open the 
chest at the edge of the sand, to get 3 potions, and then go through the
set of bones that make up a door.

subject: Tristam
text: Saying Sorry to Tristam after he blows open the door reduces his price for 50 bombs from 30GP to 15GP.

evidence.quote:
Tristam will blow it open with a bomb! He'll then offer to sell you 50
bombs for 30GP. Say "Sorry" and he'll cut the price to 15GP, where you
have no choice but to pay - but that's god, you want those bombs!

subject: Treasure chest
text: Blowing up a set of bones on the ground reveals a treasure chest containing a Steel Shield that boosts defense by 5 points.

evidence.quote:
There's aset of bones lying
on the ground. Use a bomb to blow them up. There's a treasure chest
containing a Steel Shield behind them, and it will boost your defense by
5 points!

subject: Treasure chest
text: Blow apart a blocked door on the northeast part of the room to find a Roc and a chest of Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote:
On the north
east part of the room, you can blow apart a blocked door. A Roc, and a
chest of Ninja Stars is behind it.

subject: Treasure chest
text: On the right side of the room, a chest full of bombs is guarded by a Gorgon.

evidence.quote:
On the right side of the next room, is a chest full of bombs, blocked by
a Gorgon.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Enter a hidden room through the right wall and jump across rocks to find a chest containing 10 ninja stars.

evidence.quote:
If you 
walk all the wya to the right, into the wall, you can enter a hidden
room. Jump across the rocks here, to find a chest with 10 ninja stars
inside it.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Defeat the Gorgon and Skeleton out of the mouth of bones to reach a chest containing 10 Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote:
On the tight side, out of the mouth of the bones, is a Gorgon, and a 
Skeleton. If you defeat one, or both of them, you can access another
chest with 10 Ninja Stars inside.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Moving to the left past the Skeleton reveals a Minotaur Zombie blocking a treasure chest containing 10 Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote:
Kill him, and
move to the left. A Minotaur Zombie is blocking a treasure chest with 10
Ninja Stars in it.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Bomb the teeth of the wall skull to enter the next room and collect 3 seeds.

evidence.quote:
Bomb its teeth, to open a path. Go
straight, into the next room, where you can pick up 3 seeds.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Bomb the teeth on another skull and head down the bones into a room with a chest containing the Quake spell.

evidence.quote:
On the other side, is another Skull with teeth to bomb.
Head straight, down the bones, and into another room. A chest containing
the Quake spell is here, and you'll want to pick it up!
